{{Youmay|the species of animal from Sullust|[[Seluss (Sullustan)|Seluss]], a Sullustan named after them}}
{{Top|leg}}
'''Seluss''' were snakes from [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. When [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] miners saw a seluss in a tunnel, they knew the air was safe to breathe.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Many [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] males were named for the species,<ref name="GCG" /> including [[Seluss (Sullustan)|Seluss]], a smuggler.<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>
